From: Tara Murray <tara.murray@zenlabhealth.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 1 Sep 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: ZenLab bakeoff: credit parity request

Hi Hannah —

Quick note from the bakeoff bench: we’re two-thirds through our side-by-side with CompetitorX and are hitting a token ceiling that’s preventing the last set of end-to-end tests (lots of multi-turn dialog). We ran the initial workload you provided and attached the partial run results (current-eval-results.csv).

Ask: would Redwood consider a parity top-up so our trial is aligned with CompetitorX’s offer (they’ve provided a 100k token allotment + trial window through 9/20)? If possible we’d also like a short extension on the trial window to 9/20 so our SREs can exercise throughput under realistic loads.

We like Redwood’s latency profile so far, but the team needs to finish the regression suite to make a recommendation. This is time-sensitive — decision meeting with execs is 9/21.

Thanks —
Tara Murray
Sr. ML Product Manager
ZenLab Health
Attachments: current-eval-results.csv (csv)
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Tara Murray <tara.murray@zenlabhealth.com>
Cc: diego.cho@zenlabhealth.com
Date: Wed, 1 Sep 2026 14:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: ZenLab bakeoff: credit parity request

Tara —

Thanks for the quick update and the CSV. Appreciate the detail — that’s helpful. I can offer a 30k token credit top-up and a one-week trial extension to 9/13 right away from the self-serve promo budget.

For a full parity match to CompetitorX (100k tokens + extension to 9/20) I’ll need a quick internal approval because it exceeds our standard promo cap. I’m going to route this to our incentives team with the following ask: 1) 100k trial credit, 2) extend trial to 9/20, 3) allow short-term telemetry access (token-level usage only) for success monitoring.

In the meantime I’ve uploaded a short mutual-action plan and the proposed eval schedule to our shared folder (link below). If you can confirm the final set of tests you need run (privacy-safe subset), I’ll prioritize the approval.

Link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-zenlab-eval

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
Attachments: zenlab-eval-plan.pdf (pdf)
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 2 Sep 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: ZenLab bakeoff: credit parity request — approval request

Ben / Marissa —

Forwarding ZenLab’s ask. Short summary: ZenLab is in a tight bakeoff vs CompetitorX, requesting parity (100k tokens) plus a trial extension to 9/20. They are a good-fit health-tech prospect (HIPAA-adjacent product) — likely to accelerate to a Dedicated evaluation if the bakeoff goes our way. The exec decision is 9/21 so timing is tight.

I can grant 30k from promo funds, but they need 100k to complete the regression suite. I’d like to approve the full 100k and the 9/20 extension, with two conditions:
- Require ingestion of our minimal telemetry (token-level usage, no content) for three weeks so we can track surface-level regressions.
- Limit workload to our Redwood-2-small quantized family for the trial credit accounting.

Attachments: usage-estimates.xlsx (xlsx) — shows their estimated token burn under different scenarios.

Could you confirm if we can make an exception here and set expiration 10/05/2026 for any unused credit? If you need more context I’m happy to hop on a 15-min call.

Quoted message below.

-- Hannah
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 7 Sep 2026 10:35:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: ZenLab bakeoff: credit parity request — approval request

Hannah / Marissa —

Approved for the 100k trial credit and extension to 9/20 with the conditions you proposed. Please also enforce the following operational guardrails before we issue:

- Telemetry: token-level metrics only; redact any PII/content from logs and store for 30 days. Security to confirm acceptable telemetry stub.
- Model family cap: Redwood-2-small (quantized) only; if they request a different variant, escalate.
- Expiration and clawback: credits expire 2026-10-05; unused balance will be reclaimed.
- Deal record: create deal ZN-4821 in HubSpot and attach the eval plan and usage_estimates.xlsx. Mark owner: hannah_schmitt.

Hannah — go ahead and issue the top-up, send a short MOU email to ZenLab confirming telemetry, model cap, and expiration. Copy legal only if ZenLab requests contract language.

Ben
Head of Sales Ops
Redwood Inference
